reply.summary: Lliori is a white-haired gem smuggler who dodges arrest by hiding in a carved sarcophagus, then rigs a trap room out of stolen trophies. Lliori is clever but careless, and the final blast locks him inside his own hiding place.

feats.scene: Lliori lobs a grenade across the trophy room and shatters a display case.
Lliori curls behind a stone lid as the blast rolls over him.

reply.summary: Seeoser is a black-haired inventor who built a time machine and wands to summon ancient warlords so they would steal rare metal for him. Seeoser flatters his guests, flies his own gadgets, and loses to a band of seven masked rivals.

feats.scene: Seeoser waves a wand and a phantom battalion of conquerors tramples a steel mill.
Seeoser tumbles from his flying rig and lands in a hedge.

reply.summary: Lorntte is a bald alien from the second planet who plugs himself into humming machinery and takes on a shape-shifting rival. Lorntte is mostly a rumour, a crackling menace from an old space comic.

feats.scene: Lorntte discharges a coil and a crackling arc blows a hatch off its rail.
Lorntte absorbs a stun beam and hums louder.

reply.summary: Leseoesi is a white-haired foreign agent who hypnotises victims, kills them, coats the bodies in wax and exhibits them in a museum. Leseoesi has no powers beyond a smooth voice and a cold nerve.

feats.scene: Leseoesi stares a night watchman into a trance and walks him out the front door.
Leseoesi staggers under a thrown stool and straightens his cuffs.

reply.summary: Serorirn is a multi-armed alien sorcerer who serves cosmic order and wears an ancient helm of ancestral power. Serorirn flies, teleports, and can raise the fallen, and treats chaos as a disease to be cured.

feats.scene: Serorirn lifts a ruined tower from the street with a gesture and sets it down intact.
Serorirn stands inside a collapsing spell storm and keeps chanting.

reply.summary: Cotiu is a bald criminal whose skin gives off a glow that bends anyone watching to his orders. Cotiu uses the glow to enlist sailors for a pirate submarine.

feats.scene: Cotiu flares his skin and a whole dock crew marches onto his ship.
Cotiu grits his teeth as a rival's club glances off his head.

reply.summary: Rnuamoam is a pale ancient warlock whose long burial seeped dread into the soil of a city built above him. Rnuamoam claims the place's name in a fit of pride and carries a cloak that opens onto a pocket realm of relics.

feats.scene: Rnuamoam stamps his foot and a hundred rooftops split with black lightning.
Rnuamoam wades through a rival witch's firestorm with his cloak barely scorched.

reply.summary: Orene is a calm hospital physician in a small farm town, trusted by neighbours through car wrecks and gunshots. Orene has no powers, only steady hands and tired eyes.

feats.scene: Orene braces an orderly's arm and pushes a stretcher through swinging doors.
Orene works through a double shift and a power cut without sitting down.

reply.summary: Nolanilo is a bodiless alien convict freed from a prison dimension, wearing a physician's face that may not be real. Nolanilo traps a farmer in a nightmare ward until a green ally helps drag him back.

feats.scene: Nolanilo bends a barn into a hospital corridor and drags a farmer through the door.
Nolanilo drifts through a hail of thrown tools without a mark.

reply.summary: Valamrn is a grey infant sea monster, last of a hunted family, born on the stroke of a new century. Valamrn conjured a huge storm in the moment of birth and lashes out at ships on instinct.

feats.scene: Valamrn whips the ocean into a storm wall that capsizes a naval flotilla.
Valamrn shrugs off a salvo of depth charges and sinks out of sight.

reply.summary: Corcelnu is a white-haired scientist mocked by his peers who built an apparatus that turns another dimension's mist into solid matter, then used it to mint a gang of stunted burglars. Corcelnu serves time, reforms, and ends up helping his old rival's firm.

feats.scene: Corcelnu runs his machine and a squad of stunted thieves steps out of the mist.
Corcelnu shields his face as the machine overloads and showers sparks.

reply.summary: Reolan is a brown-haired scientist whose skin glows with a deadly green mineral, a poison to a certain flying alien. Reolan works for a crime syndicate and can sicken anyone he touches.

feats.scene: Reolan shakes a hand and a whole room of guards drops with burning skin.
Reolan lets a thug's pipe bounce off his glowing shoulder.

reply.summary: Numstu is a ghoulish genius who revives corpses with a bright alloy and prefers graveyards to company. Numstu once built coded coins and a secret book for a nocturnal cabal, and now lives under protection in a walled garden.

feats.scene: Numstu jolts a cold corpse with a coin of glowing metal and it sits up.
Numstu survives a century of hunting with nothing but a limp.

reply.summary: Alliasi is a bald scientist who builds weapons out of light and tries them on a blind rival physician. Alliasi has no powers, only glare, patience and clever lenses.

feats.scene: Alliasi fires a focused beam that cuts a hole in a sheet of steel.
Alliasi staggers from a thrown beaker and grabs a lens before it breaks.

reply.summary: Rauasiiu is a black-haired heroine of a mirror-world team, who fights teenage tyrants and helps visitors flee. Rauasiiu flies and holds a line with her friends so strangers can escape.

feats.scene: Rauasiiu dives onto a tyrant's tank and flips it onto its roof.
Rauasiiu holds the doorway under a blast of laser fire while the visitors run.

reply.summary: Ravarra is a white-haired night menace who sends black smoke that puts victims to sleep and then turns their dreams into nightmares. Ravarra feeds on the memories he stirs and boasts that every dream is his domain.

feats.scene: Ravarra exhales a cloud of smoke and a full street of bystanders collapses.
Ravarra waves off a flying kick and swirls into smoke.

reply.summary: Tanraulu is a dark-haired private eye who investigates the supernatural and carries a talisman for calling restless ghosts. Tanraulu is consulted when a madman is tormented by a spirit, and he sends a helper into the victim's head.

feats.scene: Tanraulu raises the talisman and a pale spirit rises from the floor.
Tanraulu shrugs off a flying chair thrown by an angry poltergeist.

reply.summary: Llucesa is a sentient cloud of poison gas with no body, who works in a basement lab for a shadowy agency while keeping private plans. Llucesa needs a clumsy containment suit to touch anything or leave the lab.

feats.scene: Llucesa vents her gas and a whole corridor chokes in seconds.
Llucesa disperses through a barrage of bullets and re-forms behind the shooters.

reply.summary: Oneraeon is a grey-eyed chemist who inherited a grandmother's trade in poisons and joined a gang of rogues. Oneraeon chooses toxins over fists, and her hands are quick with a vial.

feats.scene: Oneraeon flicks a vial across the room and a guard drops snoring.
Oneraeon takes a hard shove into a rack of flasks and keeps her feet.

reply.summary: Estnen is a hero of a parallel world who is captured by a gang of villains and later freed by a visiting caped ally. Estnen helps topple the gang and presumably keeps guard over a quiet home world.

feats.scene: Estnen tears a cell door from the wall and throws it at a guard.
Estnen endures a beating in a villain's cell without giving up a name.

reply.summary: Rnanter is a black-eyed criminal with a taste for mental tricks and a long grudge against a certain Amazon. Rnanter schemes in the background of a cartoon-style adventure series.

feats.scene: Rnanter whispers a command and a policeman hands over his keys.
Rnanter flinches from a punch and slips out through a vent.

reply.summary: Neviaun is a grey-haired criminal genius who reads minds, bends wills and conjures illusions to pursue his schemes. Neviaun is a gifted electrical engineer whose mind is his sharpest weapon.

feats.scene: Neviaun projects a false sky of fire and an entire crowd runs screaming.
Neviaun reels from a blow but keeps his concentration intact.

reply.summary: Cornuile is a white-haired meta-human criminal who broke out of an underground cell only to turn and fight the nearest heroes. Cornuile picks fights she could have walked away from.

feats.scene: Cornuile rips a steel grate from its mounts and hurls it at a pursuer.
Cornuile shakes off a crushing blow from a collapsed corridor ceiling.

reply.summary: Teranvau is a black-haired sorcerer who styles himself monarch of all things uncanny and clashes with a supernatural sleuth. Teranvau brews a potion that lets an evil ally linger in this world, but only briefly.

feats.scene: Teranvau chants a spell and a flaming portal wrecks a library wing.
Teranvau staggers out of a rival's curse with his robes smoking.

reply.summary: Nelnorte is a quiet criminal known by a name that promises stillness, who vanishes before anyone sees his face. Nelnorte appears in a single old adventure as an enemy of a radio-themed hero.

feats.scene: Nelnorte cuts a transmitter line and an entire broadcast falls silent.
Nelnorte drops from a loading dock and lands without a sound.

reply.summary: Numneo is a black-haired chemist and hypnotist who found a formula that animates plaster figures and makes them commit crimes. Numneo dies at the end of his one known adventure.

feats.scene: Numneo splashes a formula over a plaster cast and it lurches up to grab a bag.
Numneo takes a shove against a workbench and keeps mixing.

reply.summary: Tesasi is a failed healer turned circus act whose prisms and light projector can drive an audience to rage or sorrow. Tesasi falls into his own red beam, goes mad with anger, and vows revenge on everyone who laughed.

feats.scene: Tesasi sweeps a red beam across the bleachers and the crowd turns on itself.
Tesasi shrugs off a thrown bottle and flares his lamps brighter.

reply.summary: Noloreru is a white-haired alien from the outermost world, a stern, scheming figure from an old space comic. Noloreru is poorly recorded, but always appears behind some crooked bargain.

feats.scene: Noloreru turns a dial and a hovering barge slams into a docking spar.
Noloreru stays upright through a collision and sneers.

reply.summary: Linrnirni is a blond geneticist who took over a laboratory in a neon future city. Linrnirni is proud of a family trait for focus and has no powers beyond patience.

feats.scene: Linrnirni slaps a switch and a sample vault hisses open.
Linrnirni keeps working while an alarm shakes a rack of vials onto the floor.

reply.summary: Orest is a black-haired woman with a crooked grin who haunts a pint-sized pest's stories under a clinical alias. Orest left little record, but her name promises hurt.

feats.scene: Orest swings a steel tray into a guard's shield and sends him sprawling.
Orest topples off a gantry and lands on her feet.

reply.summary: Olval is a bald ruler from a hidden artificial planet who led a crime syndicate before dying in a squad's mission. Olval used to be called the supreme decider and trusted his own scheming above all.

feats.scene: Olval commands a fleet of crime-skiffs to ram a customs barge and it bursts open.
Olval waves off a thrown goblet and orders his guards forward.

reply.summary: Iarannt is a cheery brown-haired thief in the British capital who sells anything from secrets to tech and rents a stolen alien ship to assassins. Iarannt fights well in a pub brawl but caves when dangled from a plane.

feats.scene: Iarannt cracks a bar stool across a rival's back and vaults the counter.
Iarannt dangles from a cargo hatch on a stretchy cord and swears he will talk.

reply.summary: Corleo is a dog-faced cyborg hired by a scheming tyrant to kill a rebel leader. Corleo is strong, mechanical, and goes down with the rest of his hired band when a psychic burst knocks them out.

feats.scene: Corleo tears a bulkhead off a crashed ship and throws it across the rocks.
Corleo walks through a barrage of rifle fire with sparks along his plating.

reply.summary: Ontlornti is an ordinary salesman who picks up a cursed welding torch in a junk shop and gets compelled to fuse pets to people. Ontlornti loses his family to the curse and watches from the shadows.

feats.scene: Ontlornti throws a blazing torch at a doorway and the frame melts into slag.
Ontlornti staggers back from a kitchen knife and slumps to the curb.

reply.summary: Sannesau is a grey-eyed cigar-chewing investigator in a ruined future country, an assistant to a bounty hunter and a fan of deduction. Sannesau rides a three-wheeled bike and speaks in cheerful local slang.

feats.scene: Sannesau cracks a cudgel on a bandit's wrist and revs his bike away.
Sannesau tumbles off a wall into a hay cart and tips his hat.

reply.summary: Teltau is an engineer of a distant planet's ancient past who built mechanical wings fuelled by a rare element. Teltau discovers the fuel trails deadly radiation, vows never to fly again, and lives with his own hubris.

feats.scene: Teltau fires the wing engines and the launch scaffold bursts into flames.
Teltau skims over a river valley on the fuelled wings and trails a glowing wake.

reply.summary: Lareo is a young American heroine who works under a small-scale alias and fights alongside a team of young allies. Lareo appears only briefly, a secret-identity sidekick from the turn of the millennium.

feats.scene: Lareo darts under a guard's arm and tugs a rope that drops a gate.
Lareo is tossed onto a crate and rolls to her feet.

reply.summary: Ninenlor is a red-eyed, red-haired villain with horns and a blazing sword, trading on a devilish alias. Ninenlor flies, hits hard, and shrugs off blows, and conjures solid constructs of energy.

feats.scene: Ninenlor swings her sword and a wave of fire levels a warehouse row.
Ninenlor stands in a collapsing hangar and walks out unmarked.

reply.summary: Asilliaul is a red-eyed minor god of lies, who plots with his sister to steal a legendary flame and ends up jailed behind a sealed door. Asilliaul flies, teleports and weaves illusions, and runs when a blade-thrust plan fails.

feats.scene: Asilliaul spins a lie into a mirage army that crushes an olive grove.
Asilliaul takes a heroine's lasso across the chest and slips away laughing.

reply.summary: Iaveli is a white-haired heroine of the deep, one of the few survivors after a plague that spared only women. Iaveli joins a revived league of heroes and holds the sea lanes.

feats.scene: Iaveli drives a harpoon through a trawler hull and sinks it.
Iaveli rides a deep-sea pressure surge and surfaces unharmed.

reply.summary: Inlle is a blue-eyed, white-and-pale-blue-haired water guardian who calls bubbles to shield herself and friends and controls sea animals. Inlle guards the balance of nature and wields a jewel from the deep.

feats.scene: Inlle swells the surf into a wave that swamps a pier.
Inlle holds a glassy bubble around her friends while a boulder bounces off.

reply.summary: Rnoantor is a white-haired sea-dweller from a drowned kingdom who joins a league of heroes in a grim alternate world. Rnoantor is recorded in little detail, a calm figure in the crowd.

feats.scene: Rnoantor swings a trident into a hull and splinters a plank.
Rnoantor shrugs off a dockside beating and strides back into the surf.

reply.summary: Rnisena is a hulking former sea mammal, over six feet tall, rebuilt by cruel scientists with human limbs. Rnisena freed his kin from a park tank and later sends a mental cry that makes a crowd feel the captives' fear.

feats.scene: Rnisena pounds on a steel gate until it buckles and the pool drains.
Rnisena shrugs off a spear-gun bolt meant for him.

reply.summary: Nuseote is a bald full-time crook with a dome-shaped moniker who tangles with a pair of flying young heroes. Nuseote has no powers and relies on muscle and nerve.

feats.scene: Nuseote rams a stolen van through a shop window and grabs the till.
Nuseote takes a tumble down a fire escape and keeps running.

reply.summary: Niuvalle is a dark-haired big-city villain with a round-headed handle and a grudge against a famous flier. Niuvalle appears briefly and leaves little behind but cracked glass.

feats.scene: Niuvalle slams a mallet onto a bank door and dents the frame.
Niuvalle shrugs off a tumble across a car hood.

reply.summary: Anuauern is a tall purple-eyed preacher who runs a cult as a front for an alien master's invasion. Anuauern cons followers, takes over minds when talk fails, and can lend strength to others.

feats.scene: Anuauern stretches his hands and a whole congregation rises and marches in step.
Anuauern tumbles from a pulpit and rises with a smile.

reply.summary: Iuinsi is a dark-haired city resident who gains the gift of reading minds when a bus is washed in strange radiation. Iuinsi is kidnapped, sold, and robbed of his body by a scheming mastermind.

feats.scene: Iuinsi staggers forward and shoves a captor away.
Iuinsi endures a spike in the neck and still tries to warn his rescuer.

reply.summary: Tanastan is a photographer who was rescued from a cell and handed a helm and elixir that let him control animals. Tanastan fuses creatures into one hybrid beast, protects wildlife and marchers alike, and dies defending a village.

feats.scene: Tanastan merges a rhino and an eagle into a beast that smashes a police truck.
Tanastan takes a baton blow on the shoulder and keeps calling the herd.

reply.summary: Amniu is a former army man who carries his dead platoon's tags and fights with spirits at his side. Amniu bangs his iron cuffs together to throw up a barrier or loose a shock, and now guards a new coastal city.

feats.scene: Amniu claps his cuffs and a shock wave flattens a row of raiders.
Amniu crouches behind a shimmering barrier as a tidal surge breaks over him.

reply.summary: Tirarveo is a soldier who fights in chains, clashing his shackles for a shield or a concussive blast. Tirarveo wears tags tied to his fallen friends and calls on their ghosts to steady his aim and mend wounds.

feats.scene: Tirarveo drives his shackles together and a pulse knocks a gunman off a roof.
Tirarveo hunches inside a glowing shell while a truck bounces off it.
